description: Use while the customer is still deciding — "how much is …?": the exact price of ONE eSIM for the whole route — the countries in travel order (1–8) with their networks, ONE data pool in GB for all of them and the trip length — the server price the customer would pay. A single country is a route of one. Quote it as returned, never compute, add up or scale it yourself. The result carries a buy_url for reference; when the customer says they want to buy, call start_checkout.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

days.description: Trip length in days (1–90) for the whole route, counted from the first connection anywhere on the route.

gb.description: The data pool for the WHOLE route in whole GB (1–100), shared by every country. Omit = sized for normal use (1.5 GB × days). Not sure? Call recommend_config.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

route.description: The countries of the trip in travel order (1–8, each once).

destination.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Vietnam", "Viêt Nam", "vn". Map a city to its country first.

networks.description: Optional: operator names (or codes) from get_networks for this country. Omit = its cheapest network.

name: quote_route

buy_url.description: The route builder pre-set to exactly this route. Use verbatim.

data_gb.description: ONE data pool for every country on the route (whole GB), used wherever the customer is.

days.description: Trip length, counted from the first connection anywhere on the route.

not_available.description: Requested countries variotrip cannot add (left out of the quote).

note.description: Present when something about the request had to be adjusted — read it to the customer.

price.description: FULL price of this route in currency — the amount paid. Not per day, per GB or per country.

route.description: The countries on the eSIM in travel order with the networks of each.

networks.description: Operator names included for this country.

networks_unmatched.description: Requested names this country does not have.

topup.description: How the customer adds data, days or a country later (not through the tools).

title: Quote a route
